description: What an entity is present for. Role is independent of entity_form and of biological_type: cholesterol is a lipid by chemistry and membrane_lipid by role, and only an explicit source annotation can change the latter.
forbidden_inference_rules: most frequent component in the family is the ligand
component closest to the receptor is the ligand
every organic molecule in a GPCR structure is a ligand
first item in a source ligand list is the ligand
cholesterol or any lipid is always a ligand
a chain is a ligand because it is short, or a transducer because it is long
a protein is a ligand because it is near the receptor

ligand_roles.definition: An entity annotated as acting at the receptor's orthosteric site.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source ligand annotation with function Agonist, Agonist (partial), Antagonist or Inverse agonist, matched to this entity.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Excluded when the source function names an allosteric mode.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: An entity annotated as acting at an allosteric site without a stated positive or negative direction.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source function Allosteric agonist or Allosteric antagonist.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Excluded when the source states PAM or NAM, which are more specific.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: A single chemical entity annotated as occupying both orthosteric and allosteric regions.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Explicit source statement of bitopic binding.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Not inferred from a large molecular weight or from spanning two sites geometrically.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: A pharmacological ligand covalently bonded to the receptor.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: A pharmacological source annotation AND a covalent linkage record.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: A covalent bond alone is insufficient; covalency is not pharmacology.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Both axes must be satisfied independently. Retinal in an opsin qualifies only because sources annotate it as the ligand, not because it is covalent.

ligand_roles.definition: A peptide or protein annotated as the receptor's endogenous or pharmacological ligand.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source ligand annotation of type peptide or protein, matched to a polymer chain.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Excluded for transducers, antibodies, nanobodies and fusion partners regardless of length.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: A segment of the receptor chain itself acting as the ligand after cleavage.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Official receptor annotation, cleavage-site mapping or primary-publication statement giving a residue range.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Never assigned from proximity or from receptor family membership alone.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Absent a citable range the record is emitted unresolved and queued for manual review.

ligand_roles.definition: A second pharmacologically relevant entity present alongside a primary ligand.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: A structure carries more than one source-annotated ligand and this entity is not the first-listed.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Ordering is presentational only and carries no scientific priority.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Per OD-07 no ligand is designated primary; this role marks co-occurrence, not subordination.

ligand_roles.definition: An entity annotated PAM or Ago-PAM.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source function PAM or Ago-PAM.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: An entity annotated NAM.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source function NAM.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: An entity annotated as binding allosterically without altering efficacy.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Explicit source statement.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Not a default for unclassified allosteric binders.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Assigned only when a source annotates this entity as the structure's ligand with the corresponding pharmacological function. Frequency, size and proximity carry no weight.

ligand_roles.definition: An entity required for function or for the partner protein's chemistry, not a receptor ligand.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Source function Cofactor, or a nucleotide bound to a transducer chain (GDP/GTP analogues in G proteins).
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Excluded when a source annotates the entity as the receptor's ligand.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: The binding partner matters: GDP in a Gα subunit is a transducer cofactor, not a receptor ligand.

ligand_roles.definition: An ion present as part of the chemical environment.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Biological type ion and no pharmacological source annotation.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Overridden only by an explicit source record giving the ion a pharmacological role, which requires manual review.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Per OD-08 this is the default for Na+ including the conserved 2x50 sodium pocket, which is a motif cofactor rather than a ligand.

ligand_roles.definition: A lipid or sterol present as membrane or mesophase environment.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Biological type lipid and no pharmacological source annotation.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: A lipid annotated by a source as the ligand takes a pharmacological role instead; this is the normal case in the Lipid receptor family.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Default for cholesterol, monoolein and oleic acid. Their frequency contributes nothing to ligand selection.

ligand_roles.definition: A detergent or amphiphile used for solubilisation.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Curated detergent list membership.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Overridden by an explicit pharmacological annotation.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Sample-preparation chemistry, recorded and excluded from pharmacology.

ligand_roles.definition: A buffer, salt, precipitant or cryoprotectant.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Curated additive list membership.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Overridden by an explicit pharmacological annotation.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Covers PEG, glycerol, sulfate, acetate and similar.

ligand_roles.definition: A glycan or other post-translational modification.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Branched entity, or curated saccharide list membership.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Structural feature of the protein, not a ligand.

ligand_roles.definition: A component present because of the engineered construct.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Bound to a fusion partner rather than to the receptor, or a known construct additive.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Kept separate so construct chemistry never enters receptor pharmacology.

ligand_roles.definition: A G-protein subunit, arrestin or other signalling partner chain.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: UniProt accession or entity description matching the curated transducer table.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Never assigned from chain length or from proximity to the receptor.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: A structural observation only; it is never promoted to a pathway claim (SD-04).

ligand_roles.definition: An antibody fragment, single-domain antibody or scFv.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Entity description or UniProt evidence of an immunoglobulin fold used as a crystallisation or conformational chaperone.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: An antibody that a source annotates as the pharmacological ligand takes a pharmacological role instead.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Retained as a structure entity but produces no pharmacological observation.

ligand_roles.definition: A soluble protein fused to the receptor to aid expression or crystallisation.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Curated fusion table match (BRIL/cytochrome b562, T4 lysozyme, rubredoxin, PGS, flavodoxin, thermostabilised apocytochrome), whether a separate chain or a chimeric segment.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: When fused into the receptor entity the chain remains a receptor instance and the fusion is recorded as construct engineering, not as a separate ligand.

ligand_roles.definition: A protein partner that is neither ligand, transducer, antibody nor fusion.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Identified protein chain outside the other categories, e.g. RAMPs or scaffolding proteins.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: Not a fallback for unidentified chains, which are unresolved.

ligand_roles.definition: The role could not be determined from available sources.
ligand_roles.inclusion_rule: Default when evidence is absent, insufficient or contradictory.
ligand_roles.exclusion_rule: May not be used where the sources do support a determination.
ligand_roles.decision_logic: Routed to the manual review queue. An honest unresolved is preferred to a confident guess.

vocabulary_status.policy: A value outside this file may not appear in any Phase 2 artefact. The test suite fails on an unknown value. Adding a value requires an entry in governance/DECISION_LOG.md.
